description: Get an llms.txt index for any link: title, one-line summary, and sections of the most useful links with short descriptions. Returns the site’s own llms.txt when it has one. Cached 24h.

fresh.description: Ignore the 24h cache and rebuild. Default false.

url.description: Any public http(s) link, e.g. "docs.stripe.com/payments", "github.com/honojs/hono", a PDF or a video URL. The scheme is optional.

name: llms_txt
title: llms.txt for a link
